svg.text: Compress 384-dim vectors to bits — and still find what you need

g.text: Multiply by random Gaussian matrix R (seeded, deterministic)
Keep only the sign: positive → 1, negative → 0
Computed via XOR + popcount (1 CPU instruction!)
3. Quantize: angles to 4 bits (0-15), radii to 8 bits (0-255)
QJL eliminates 98% of candidates with a single XOR + popcount per vector.
PolarQuant only runs on the 200 survivors for accurate re-ranking.
Result: near-exact recall at a fraction of brute-force cost.
10,000 docs: 15 MB raw → 3.4 MB compressed (QJL + PolarQuant)
